name: vibe-studio
description: Vibe Studio skill pack for planning a new app or web product: idea, benchmark research, user flows, brand voice, design brand fitting, and PRD — written as PRODUCT.md, VOICE.md, DESIGN.md, PRD.md, with decisions logged in DECISIONS.md.

interface.shortDescription: Plan new app and web products from idea to PRD.
interface.longDescription: Vibe Studio bundles a staged product planning workflow for new app and web ideas: brainstorming, benchmark research, user-flow generation, brand voice, design-system brand fitting, and PRD synthesis. Outputs follow the PRODUCT.md / VOICE.md / DESIGN.md convention, and every step logs user decisions to DECISIONS.md.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a new app or web service with the Vibe Studio workflow.
